message:
docs(release): a filename in the binary is not the payload's bytes

The release note offered a UTF-16 scan for filenames as evidence that the
installer carries the right payload. It is not. It is enough for what it
was originally for -- confirming ui\shell.html survives unmangled, the
escape defect from #468 -- and no more.

What actually establishes it is parsing the PE resource directory,
extracting each RT_RCDATA entry and comparing it to the staged file: nine
of nine matching on size and SHA256, with no unexpected resource ids.

The rebuild comparison is recorded as the separate thing it is. Forty bytes
differ, thirty-six of them inside .rsrc, and each one is a COFF or Debug
TimeDateStamp of an embedded PE; the two html files are byte-identical, no
byte is unaccounted for, and the CodeView GUIDs are unchanged. That is a
measurement that the difference is confined to timestamps -- not the
general claim that reproducible builds are impossible here, which would
have excused a difference nobody had looked at.

Also: check permissions from the APK, not from build/intermediates. The
release intermediates do not carry the new permission and would support the
opposite conclusion.
